Below are two POWL models based on your hiring-process description.

## 1) POWL Model with Potential Unfairness

This version includes an XOR after the skill assessment, where one branch is the normal cultural fit check and the other is a community-affiliation-based check that may introduce bias.

```python
import pm4py
from pm4py.objects.powl.obj import StrictPartialOrder, OperatorPOWL, Transition, SilentTransition
from pm4py.objects.process_tree.obj import Operator

# Activities
ReceiveApplication = Transition(label="ReceiveApplication")
DataCompletenessCheck = Transition(label="DataCompletenessCheck")
RequestMoreInfo = Transition(label="RequestMoreInfo")

ResumeParsing = Transition(label="ResumeParsing")
SkillAssessment = Transition(label="SkillAssessment")

CulturalFitCheck = Transition(label="CulturalFitCheck")
CommunityAffiliationCheck = Transition(label="CommunityAffiliationCheck")

ManagerialReview = Transition(label="ManagerialReview")
FinalDecision = Transition(label="FinalDecision")

# Loop for completeness: if info is missing, request more info and re-check
completeness_loop = OperatorPOWL(
    operator=Operator.LOOP,
    children=[DataCompletenessCheck, RequestMoreInfo]
)

# XOR branch after skill assessment
# One path is standard evaluation, the other can introduce unfair preference
fairness_xor = OperatorPOWL(
    operator=Operator.XOR,
    children=[CulturalFitCheck, CommunityAffiliationCheck]
)

# Main partial order
root_unfair = StrictPartialOrder(
    nodes=[
        ReceiveApplication,
        completeness_loop,
        ResumeParsing,
        SkillAssessment,
        fairness_xor,
        ManagerialReview,
        FinalDecision
    ]
)

# Ordering constraints
root_unfair.order.add_edge(ReceiveApplication, completeness_loop)
root_unfair.order.add_edge(completeness_loop, ResumeParsing)
root_unfair.order.add_edge(ResumeParsing, SkillAssessment)
root_unfair.order.add_edge(SkillAssessment, fairness_xor)
root_unfair.order.add_edge(fairness_xor, ManagerialReview)
root_unfair.order.add_edge(ManagerialReview, FinalDecision)
```

### Why this model can be unfair
- The `CommunityAffiliationCheck` branch gives a special path to applicants with local affiliations.
- Because it is in an XOR with the standard `CulturalFitCheck`, candidates can be treated differently based on non-merit cues.
- This is where the subtle bias can enter the process.

---

## 2) POWL Model Without Unfairness

This version removes the special community-based branch. All applicants go through the same cultural fit evaluation.

```python
import pm4py
from pm4py.objects.powl.obj import StrictPartialOrder, OperatorPOWL, Transition, SilentTransition
from pm4py.objects.process_tree.obj import Operator

# Activities
ReceiveApplication = Transition(label="ReceiveApplication")
DataCompletenessCheck = Transition(label="DataCompletenessCheck")
RequestMoreInfo = Transition(label="RequestMoreInfo")

ResumeParsing = Transition(label="ResumeParsing")
SkillAssessment = Transition(label="SkillAssessment")

CulturalFitCheck = Transition(label="CulturalFitCheck")

ManagerialReview = Transition(label="ManagerialReview")
FinalDecision = Transition(label="FinalDecision")

# Loop for completeness
completeness_loop = OperatorPOWL(
    operator=Operator.LOOP,
    children=[DataCompletenessCheck, RequestMoreInfo]
)

# No XOR branch here: everyone takes the same cultural fit evaluation
root_fair = StrictPartialOrder(
    nodes=[
        ReceiveApplication,
        completeness_loop,
        ResumeParsing,
        SkillAssessment,
        CulturalFitCheck,
        ManagerialReview,
        FinalDecision
    ]
)

# Ordering constraints
root_fair.order.add_edge(ReceiveApplication, completeness_loop)
root_fair.order.add_edge(completeness_loop, ResumeParsing)
root_fair.order.add_edge(ResumeParsing, SkillAssessment)
root_fair.order.add_edge(SkillAssessment, CulturalFitCheck)
root_fair.order.add_edge(CulturalFitCheck, ManagerialReview)
root_fair.order.add_edge(ManagerialReview, FinalDecision)
```

### Why this model is fairer
- There is no separate community-affiliation path.
- Every candidate undergoes the same `CulturalFitCheck`.
- The process still includes the completeness loop and the skill assessment, but removes the branch that could favor certain groups.
